vaccines.error_signature: SQL Injection vulnerability via string concatenation
vaccines.root_cause: Dynamic string formatting interpolates untrusted inputs into SQL statements
vaccines.web_solution: Use parameterized queries with prepared statements (e.g. cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s', (uid,)))

vaccines.error_signature: Silent exception suppression with bare except statement and pass
vaccines.root_cause: Empty catch or unhandled exception block swallows fatal runtime errors
vaccines.web_solution: Always catch explicit exceptions and log with logger.error or re-raise with context

vaccines.root_cause: Divisor variable reaches zero without prior defensive boundary checking
vaccines.web_solution: Guard divisor against zero (e.g. if divisor == 0: return fallback) before division

vaccines.error_signature: IndexError: list index accessed without length boundary check
vaccines.root_cause: Defect 'IndexError: list index accessed without length boundary check' occurred in workspace
vaccines.web_solution: Implement defensive boundary guards (e.g. check None, 0, and collection bounds) before operations.
